head: Subscribe, run SETUP, play.
steps: Press Subscribe on the SEST Integration Pack and subscribe to all its required items (about 24 GB). Let Steam finish.
In the game: Mod Manager, SEST Integration Pack, Open Folder. Then quit Sea Power.
It checks every mod is downloaded, installs the Anchor Chain preloader if missing, and sets the load order.
Southern Watch, Southern Reach, Red Line or Sulu Line for the story. Open Allocation sells everything up front.
foot: Windows may ask for permission once, for the preloader.
If the Mod Manager offers to move dependencies above the pack, say no.
Run SETUP again (game closed) after the pack or a mod updates.
